messages.subject: Possible bug related to "if" statement?
parts:
In the transformed parameters section I have lines that read:

real ifrac;
ifrac <- log(mixing_i) - log(mixing_t+mixing_s+mixing_i);

I get the error:

ifrac <- log(mixing_i)-log(mixing_t+mixing_s+mixing_i);
  ^-- here
DIAGNOSTIC(S) FROM PARSER:
Parser expecting: "("

When I change the parameter name everything compiles fine.

Ie it seems like the compiler thinks I am beginning an if statement.  Is this the desired/expected behavior? Does this mean we cannot have transformed parameter names starting with "if"? Are there other keywords that cannot begin parameter names?
